game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Glowworm Gallery, a ceiling of glowworms: the dwarf scout must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Countdown Launch: Tick a countdown down each loop until it hits zero and the launch fires.
theme: Shadow Cave – Glowworm Gallery: a ceiling of glowworms
core_gameplay_loop: In Glowworm Gallery, repeat each round: Tick a countdown down each loop until it hits zero and the launch fires. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the count value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the wooden door using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The wooden door reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the wooden door is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Countdown Launch
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Countdown Launch' (Week 4 slot 2), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Glowworm Gallery'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how count changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cave spiders in Glowworm Gallery.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The wooden door reached with actions_used <= 19.
